entries.text: Sable Instruments registers one purpose statement for its catalogue and defers the billing model of each item to that item's registered product record.
Sable Field Recorder: a handheld two-channel recorder with locking inputs. The registered listing records neither a documented intended use nor an applicable billing model.
Regional distributor terms. Billing model: this recorder is sold as a one-time purchase with no subscription.
Global distributor terms. Billing model: this recorder is sold through a recurring annual subscription.
